body.name: Kivotos
body.description: Greek restaurant in Canberra offering seafood, grilled meats and signature desserts at the Hellenic Club.

_enrich.description: Experience authentic Greek dining in Canberra at Kivotos on Mort Street, Braddon, and inside the Woden Hellenic Club. Inspired by Greece’s sun-drenched landscapes and vibrant traditions, our menu showcases classic and modern flavours - from prawn saganaki with ouzo and feta to tender Greek lamb chops with couscous salad and spiced saffron yoghurt. End your culinary journey with loukoumades drizzled in honey, walnuts, and cinnamon. Step into our bright, welcoming space with blond wood tables, banquette seating, and lush greenery, and let every dish tell a story of Greek passion, history, and flavour.

media_input.description: Greek restaurant in Canberra offering seafood, grilled meats and signature desserts at the Hellenic Club.
